sections.heading: Roles, security, and scale.
body: Run many sites and a big team on one console — with granular roles, audit trails, custom domains, and room to grow, backed by an open, self-hostable platform.

sections.heading: Running dozens of sites usually means dozens of logins, vendors, and gaps. Aglyn brings every site into one console — with the roles, audit, and governance a large team needs.
Built for teams that need control.

items.title: Every site, one console
items.body: Manage up to 25 hosts on Advanced from a single organization, with room to add more.

items.title: Granular roles & permissions
items.body: Owner, admin, editor, and viewer — plus custom roles and per-site access for large teams.

items.title: Audit & accountability
items.body: A live activity feed shows who published, changed, or ordered what, across every site.

items.title: Governance at scale
items.body: Scheduled publishing, versioning with rollback, and site backup and restore keep changes safe.

items.title: One bill, many sites
items.body: Manage plans, seats, members, and usage for the whole org from one billing hub.

items.title: Own your platform
items.body: Self-host the Apache-2.0 platform with Docker behind your own infrastructure, or let us run it — either way your team can audit the code.

sections.heading: Many sites, one source of truth.
body: Run every brand, region, or product site as a host under one organization — with shared roles, billing, and governance, and an Apache-2.0 codebase your team can audit.

items.title: Scale without ceilings
items.body: Advanced runs 25 sites, Agency runs 100 — and Enterprise contracts are sized to your portfolio, with volume pricing.

items.title: Shared governance
items.body: Roles, scheduled publishing, and audit apply across every site.

items.title: Self-host option
items.body: Self-host the Apache-2.0 platform, or audit the source your sites run on.

sections.heading: Single sign-on (SAML / OIDC), an uptime SLA with a public status page, priority support with a named success manager, and a security & compliance kit are in active planning for Enterprise contracts.

items.title: Set up your org
items.body: Create your organization and add every site your teams run as a host.

items.title: Define roles
items.body: Give each person the exact access they need with roles and custom permissions.

items.title: Publish with guardrails
items.body: Schedule releases, roll back versions, and keep a full audit trail.

items.title: Console
items.body: Run every site, team, and setting in one place.

items.title: Workflows
items.body: Automate the busywork with triggers & actions.

items.title: Analytics
items.body: Privacy-first traffic, top pages & store revenue.

sections.heading: Bring your team to Aglyn.
body: Talk to us about roles, scale, and self-hosting for your organization.
